messages:
Alex: FYI a customer (Acme Retail) reported repeated invoice autopay failures this morning. root cause looks like issuer risk challenge -> 3DS popup that our flow doesn't surface. charge id: ch_1GqXabc, call_id: req_abc123
Maria: can you drop the logs / request link?
Alex: https://console.re/requests/req_abc123 (redacted). Webhook shows status=declined code=issuer_risk_challenge message='challenge_required'
Sam: Customer says they see 'Authentication Required' then nothing — autopay retries are marking as failed immediately.
Nika (support-bot): Detected related incidents: invoice_autopay-acs-timeout (5 matches)
Maria: Quick repro I ran: created a test invoice with bill_to.country=IE and card with GB BIN, autorenew on. Repro curl: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/charges -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_..." -d '{"invoice_id":"inv_123","payment_method":"pm_card_visa","auto_pay":true}'` — gateway responded with issuer_risk_challenge
Alex: Repro notes: ACS redirect returns a 302 to the acquirer-hosted page with an ACS form, our HTTP client follows redirect and ends up discarding the form body, we treat it as non-ACS and mark failed. Logs show acs_result: 'challenge_flow' then issuer_response: 'fraud_risk'
Sam: Also flagged that billing metadata might be influencing risk: customer requires PO numbers + VAT. Gateways sometimes step up SCA for B2B cross-border if PO missing.
Maria: The webhook payload included: `billing_metadata.po_number: null, billing_metadata.vat_id: "GB999"` — so PO was missing on the attempt.
Alex: Proposed mitigation: add explicit handling for issuer_risk_challenge to surface a hosted-iframe fallback for SCA / ACS flows and extend autopay retry window so a customer can complete challenge. Marking as high priority for this enterprise account.
Sam: Short-term workaround: disable auto-retry for this merchant and ask customer to complete payment via web checkout where we can show the ACS flow.
Maria: @eng-runtime can Private deployments surface ACS HTML blobs to the customer app?
Jordan (eng-runtime): pinged. First thought: our client lib currently strips 302 bodies due to redirect policy. We can add special-case handling when gateway returns `issuer_risk_challenge` to return the `challenge_url` or raw ACS form back in the API response. Needs RFC — risk: leaking ACS HTML if not routed correctly.
Alex: Also confirm whether acquirer includes `challenge_url` in the gateway response vs only `challenge_token`. That changes integration approach.
Sam: Attached log snippet for req_abc123: ```json
{"time":"2026-02-10T09:12:34Z","req":"req_abc123","status":"declined","reason":"issuer_risk_challenge","acs_url":"https://acs.acquirer/3ds/flow","card_bin":"400000","billing_country":"IE"}
```
Maria: OK I'm escalating to payments-ops and scheduling a customer call at 15:00 CET. :thumbsup:
Alex: Adding support ticket CS-4421 and marking escalated -> payments-ops.
Sam: Note to ops: verify 3DS indicator flags we send (`is_ecommerce`, `customer_ip`, `billing_address`) — wrong indicators can bump challenge rates.
Nika (support-bot): Case CS-4421 updated: severity=high, assignee=Maria
Maria: Will post follow-up after today's call.
